content.short: HorizonDEX is the first concentrated liquidity DEX on Linea.
content.description: HorizonDEX pioneers concentrated liquidity on the Linea network, establishing itself as a decentralized exchange that uses a targeted capital deployment model rather than traditional automated market making. By concentrating liquidity around key price ranges, its pools maximize capital efficiency and can offer liquidity providers higher potential returns. The platform is designed to deliver an unrivaled trading experience through a dedicated concentrated liquidity protocol, complemented by a suite of interoperable modules that coordinate liquidity management, pricing, routing, and yield opportunities for users across supported networks.
